content_of_post_to_answer: What are some ways to become smart?
answer: Becoming smart is less about collecting more information and more about improving the quality of your thinking. Many people confuse intelligence with knowing answers, but real intelligence shows up in asking better questions, noticing patterns, changing your mind when evidence changes, and understanding what you don't know. A smart person is not someone who is always certain; it is someone who is constantly refining their understanding.
